verdict.rationale: Resend has a structured API reference covering emails, batch, webhooks, suppressions, API keys and domains, served as markdown (resend-docs-1, resend-docs-2, resend-docs-6, resend-docs-7, resend-docs-33, resend-probe-2). A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published (resend-probe-3), and a community user praises its code snippets and idiomatic SDK examples (resend-comm-5). However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser. Missing for 10: an interactive 'try it' playground, runnable in-docs examples, and hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
